prepSteps.title: Create the Entro Snowflake user
prepSteps.instruction: In Snowflake, create the Entro user with key-pair auth and Entro's documented grants; store the private key in the operator vault, not in chat.
prepSteps.evidence: Snowflake shows the Entro user with the documented role

typedActions.mutation: snow sql -q "CREATE USER ... RSA_PUBLIC_KEY=...; GRANT ROLE ..." per Entro's documented grants; operator stores the private key in the vault
typedActions.expectedChange: Snowflake shows the Entro user with the documented role
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: DROP USER created this run after Approve
